protocol.scope: Same3 FFHQ images x4 tasks, sigma=.05, ten epochs; S10/15 fresh, S30 A71 reuse only.
protocol.grid: Low/mid/high sections fixed. Counts10:[5,3,2],15:[8,5,2],30:[15,10,5]; same original section-linear rounding.
protocol.policy: Unchanged A71 noise shrink, last unroll only. No input VJP or gamma gradient.
protocol.learning: Per-S independent from-seed zeta/D learning, same seeds per arm; no learned cache or parameter interpolation.
protocol.timing: S10/15 fresh complete10*S; model loading/warmup/metrics/writes excluded. S30 clocks inherited and explicitly tagged.
protocol.limits: Fixed epochs, variable totalNFE100/150/300; not equal-budget or adaptive step-size, no new image/dataset/seed confirmation.
